name: 39565 · Vancleave, MS
findings: ZIP 39565 (Vancleave) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39565 (Vancleave) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
